claim_scope: consumed-Dev mechanism confirmation after a shared delivery-verifier correction; not a generalization, leaderboard, SOTA, or method-effect estimate
motivation: In the earlier matched TFMA pair, the control exhausted 120 requests without submission. Live frontier formed a candidate and passed clean replay, but Official failed because the candidate ended outside the project root. The shared verifier now detects that delivery error during clean replay. The old outcome remains unchanged; this study asks whether the corrected challenger can produce a new terminal Official success.

comparison.only_treatment_difference: operation-linked live compatibility observations and latest-state frontier feedback

execution.concurrency: the two matched episodes may run concurrently on the same Spark host

primary_endpoint: valid EnvBench Official Pass@1; generation noncompletion, no submitted program, failed clean replay, and Official Fail are all Fail

decision_rule.control_fail_treatment_pass: retain Live frontier only as a challenger for a fixed treatment-unrun Dev comparison
decision_rule.control_fail_treatment_fail: reject Live frontier from the EnvSolve-Pro core regardless of intermediate obligation reduction
decision_rule.control_pass_treatment_pass: reject this case as evidence of differential gain; do not promote Live frontier
